description: React component for rendering a sidebar menu group with permission and display filtering, including primary and non-primary menu items, using Material-UI components.

methods.name: listItems
methods.description: Generates menu item components based on menu type ('collapse' or 'item') with filtering.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMenu
methods.description: Determines if a menu should be displayed based on permission and display conditions.

methods.name: renderPrimaryItems
methods.description: Retrieves primary menu items from the item.children array.

methods.name: renderNonPrimaryGroups
methods.description: Filters and prepares non-primary menu groups for rendering.
